repeat_policy: two byte-identical traces per Windows configuration; exact identities, time, requests and response flags
scope: actual production celestial module callbacks before extraction, SI true/barycentric position and velocity, existing module coordinate conventions; not world integration or session lifecycle
unused_output: Each unreturned three-vector block is explicitly zero; Sun barycentric-only requests may return zero flags, as allowed by the existing SDK
interpolation_reset: Each request-mask profile begins with an explicit fast query at -1000000 seconds, outside the previous cached bracket; the original cache is not keyed by request mask
